# European Hockey Agency (EHA)

> Personal representation for hockey players seeking clubs across European and North American markets, since 2016. Sourced, dated guidance on leagues, transfers, immigration and club selection — not speculation.

The site is bilingual: English at the root, Russian under /ru/ with the same page structure (equivalent slugs differ per page). Every factual claim on this site is dated and sourced; see the editorial methodology page for the sourcing standard.

## Start here

- [Editorial methodology](https://eurohockeyagency.com/editorial-methodology): source hierarchy, update workflow, correction policy — read this to understand how claims on this site are verified.
- [Agent](https://eurohockeyagency.com/agent): founder profile, track record, and confirmed placement numbers.
- [Cases](https://eurohockeyagency.com/cases): sourced list of confirmed player placements, each with an independent citation.
- [All guides](https://eurohockeyagency.com/guides): full index of country guides, process guides and reference material.

## Reference data

- [Hockey Market Map 2026](https://eurohockeyagency.com/guides/hockey-market-map-2026): original 19-country dataset with methodology and citation guidance.
- [European leagues by level](https://eurohockeyagency.com/european-leagues): senior league divisions across European markets, import openness, signing windows.
- [Junior hockey leagues in Europe](https://eurohockeyagency.com/junior-hockey-leagues): junior routes by country and age category.
- [News](https://eurohockeyagency.com/news): dated updates when a league or federation actually changes a rule.
